'''Gryffin Remus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who once served the [[Balmorran resistance]] until he joined the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
During [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra's]] [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|liberation]], Gryffin had crucial information on the resistance for the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] Command. He wanted to reveal these information to get attention of the Imperial occupation authorities and asked a Imperial spacer to whisper about him good word to Lieutenant [[Treshoda]] who was responsible for accepting defectors into Imperial ranks.
